title: BankUnited Names Commercial Banking Regional Market Leader for the Tampa Bay Area
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about BankUnited, Inc.'s business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
MIAMI LAKES, Fla.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 5, 2026-- BankUnited Inc. (NYSE: BKU) has named Tony Coley as senior vice president, commercial banking market leader for the Tampa Bay region. The 30-year banking industry veteran will lead the bank’s Tampa Bay commercial teams as they continue to grow BankUnited’s portfolio and extend its momentum in the region.


This press release features multimedia. View the full release here:[https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261005377031/en/](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261005377031/en/)


Tony Coley, BankUnited Senior Vice President, Commercial Banking Market Leader, Tampa Bay Region


“Tony is an exceptional professional and a seasoned leader with an established record of building effective teams that deliver results and exceed client expectations,” said Chad Loar, executive vice president, commercial banking division, BankUnited. “He is well-suited to drive BankUnited’s growth in Tampa Bay while helping our clients achieve their financial goals.”


Coley’s commercial banking experience includes leading banking franchises across Florida and the Southeast. Prior to joining BankUnited, he was executive vice president and regional president for South Florida with Seacoast Bank. He also served as group regional president at Truist Bank, overseeing 10 of its 21 community-banking regions, in six states, and regional president leading the BB&T/SunTrust merger integration in South Florida.


Coley also has a decades-long track record of community involvement, which has earned him numerous accolades, including recognition among Florida Trend’s “500 Most Influential Leaders” and South Florida Business Journal’s “250 Power Leaders in Banking & Finance.”


He graduated from the University of Miami as an Academic All American and three-year starter for the Miami Hurricanes football team, winning three conference championships. Coley later attended the Stonier Graduate School of Banking, The Wharton School, and University of Pennsylvania. A resident of Tampa Bay, he will be based in BankUnited’s office at 1828 N Westshore Blvd, Tampa, FL 33607. For more information, call (813) 281-8500 or visit[www.BankUnited.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.BankUnited.com&esheet=54616632&newsitemid=20261005377031&lan=en-US&anchor=www.BankUnited.com&index=1&md5=7bdc4d6b6766e432b137ffde2d50c553) .


**About BankUnited, N.A.**


BankUnited, Inc. (NYSE: BKU), with total assets of $34.9 billion at June 30, 2026, is the bank holding company of BankUnited, N.A., a national bank headquartered in Miami Lakes, Florida, with operations in Florida, New York, Dallas, Atlanta, Morristown, New Jersey, and Charlotte, North Carolina. BankUnited provides a full range of consumer and commercial banking products and services to individuals, small businesses, middle-market companies, large corporations and institutions, and offers certain commercial lending and deposit products through national platforms.
